summary: Florida Forest Service 100-ft tower at Marianna, contracted in 1950 with a planned HQ office; a 1954 report places a ranger there. No source describes it today.

events.note: Florida Forest Service let construction contracts for a 100-foot lookout tower at Marianna, with an office and two dwellings planned at the site. The page gives no completion date.
Ranger W.B. Martin stationed at the Marianna Fire Tower, per a March 1954 report.

evidence.supports: Announced by District Forester J. Edwin Moore
evidence.quote: District Forester J. Edwin Moore announced last week

evidence.supports: 1950 contracts let by the Florida Forest Service for a 100-foot lookout tower at Marianna
evidence.quote: Contracts have been let by the Florida Forest Service for the construction of a 100 foot lookout tower at Marianna

evidence.supports: Office and two dwellings planned for the tower site
evidence.quote: Negotiations are also underway for a contract to build an office and two dwellings at the tower-site.

evidence.supports: Office to be the county ranger's base for the Jackson County fire control unit
evidence.quote: The office will serve as the Count Ranger's headquarters for Jackson County Forest Fire Control Unit.

evidence.supports: District forester (J. Edwin Moore): four lookout towers planned for the county
evidence.quote: Moore added that four lookout towers will be erected in the county

evidence.supports: Ranger W.B. Martin stationed at the Marianna Fire Tower, one of five in the county (March 1954 report)
evidence.quote: according to W.B. Martin, ranger, stationed at the Marianna Fire Tower, one of five in this county

evidence.supports: 64 wildfires in Jackson County during February 1954
evidence.quote: During February, and a short month at that, there were 64 'wildfires' in this county

evidence.supports: February 1954 count was more than half of the 122 blazes recorded July 1953 to March 1954
evidence.quote: This figure represented more than half of the total on record from July 1, 1953 to March 1, 1954, which showed 122 blazes

evidence.supports: Patrol plane flying daily when weather allowed, described as a major lookout medium against forest fires
evidence.quote: A patrol plane piloted by D.E. Ward and flying daily, weather permitting, is proving a major lookout medium against forest fires in Jackson County

sources.title: Marianna FC HQ - Forest Lookouts (1950 and 1954 clippings from the Panama City News-Herald)

notes_for_editor: Single source: a fan transcription of 1950 and 1954 newspaper items. The brief had no agency; the 1950 item names the Florida Forest Service, so it is added. Height 30.5 m is the planned 100-foot figure from the 1950 contract item, not a measured or completed height. No status or access source found. Map listings (anyplaceamerica, getamap, opengovny) returned 403 and were not used. The 1954 item calls the tower the Marianna Fire Tower.
